name: ADAMAS ZERO
source:
A parody game featuring Gun*am SEED DESTINY.

Ne*, defeated by Kira and saved by AA. At the same time, Asl*n gets injured and saved by AA. 
What destiny awaits the three?
This is a novel adventure!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE049410.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款以《机动战士高达SEED DESTINY》为题材的恶搞游戏。

尼被基拉击败后由AA救下。同时，阿斯兰受伤，也被AA救下。
三人的命运将走向何方？
这是一部小说冒险游戏！

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE049410.html]DLsite English[/url]]
